sentences.text:
1  The PI of Yelahanka New Town Police Station has filed charge sheet against the accused for the offences punishable U/s.498 (A), 504, 506 of IPC and Section - 3 & 4 of D.P. Act.
 2.
Brief case of the prosecution is as under :

It is alleged in the chargesheet that accused - 1 got love, married CW.1 on 28.04.2011 at Lakshmi Narayana Swamy Temple, situated at Shanthinagar,
after marriage accused-1 along with CW.1 were stayed at Sahakara Nagar for 1 and half months and later started to reside at House No.38/6,
Chikkabommasandra, 4th B Main Road, within the jurisdiction of Yelahanka New Town Police Station .

3 C.C. NO.26650/2024 Accused -1 had illicit relationship with accused -4, at the instigation of accused -4 assaulted CW.1 and forced her to bring dowry from her parents house,
abused her in filthy language by using unparliamentary words and threatened her with dire consequences thus committed criminal intimidation and thereby accused has committed the offences punishable U/s. 498(A), 504, 506 of IPC and Section - 3 and 4 of D.P. Act.

3.After receipt of first information by CW-1,
Crime was registered in Crime No.0097/2012, dated 06.04.2012 and investigation was taken up.

After Yelahanka New Town Police Station vs Parvathi on 5 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88002648/
2 completion of investigation, the charge-sheet was submitted against the accused for the aforementioned offences.

sentences.text: 4.Accused-4 is on court bail.
Charge sheet materials supplied as per provisions U/s 207 of Cr.P.C.

Heard on both side, charge is framed and read  4 C.C. NO.26650/2024 over for which they pleaded not guilty and claims to be tried.
 5.
The prosecution has examined P.W.1 and got marked Ex.P.1 to 3 on its behalf.
Since, PW-1 has completely turned hostile prayer of Ld.Sr.APP for issuance of summons to other witnesses was rejected and evidence of other witnesses dropped.

As there is no incriminating evidence available against the accused recording of Statement U/s 313 of Cr.P.C.,
is dispensed.

6. Heard the arguments.
 7.

The points that arise for consideration are :
 1. Whether the prosecution has proved  beyond all reasonable doubt that  accused has committed the offences  U/s.498 (A), 504, 506 of IPC and  Section - 3 & 4 of D.P. Act.?
 2. What order ?
 8.
The above points are answered as under :
Point No.1: In the Negative.
Point No.2: As per final order for the following :

sentences.text: 3  REASONS  9.
Point No.1 :

It is the case of the prosecution that CW.1 is the legally wedded wife of accused -1 and accused -1 at the instigation of accused -4 subjected CW.1 with cruelty both physically and mentally and demanded additional dowry.
Again accused have abused CW.1 and threatened her.

10. In order to prove the guilt of the accused, the prosecution has examined PW.1, who being the complainant/victim during the course of chief- examination has completely turned hostile and stated that she does not know the contents of Ex.P1 to 3.
She signed on Ex.P1 to 3 at Police Station.
Accused have neither ill treated her physically or mentally nor demanded any additional dowry.
PW.1 further stated that accused have neither abused nor threatened her etc.,
The learned Sr.APP has cross-examined her at  6 C.C. NO.26650/2024 length.
Even during the cross-examination nothing worth has been elicited to disbelieve the version of PW.1.

During the course of cross-examination by learned Sr.APP suggested regarding compromise though PW.1 admitted, but she denied that by Yelahanka New Town Police Station vs Parvathi on 5 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88002648/
4 compromising the matter deposing false evidence .

sentences.text: Admittedly, except hostile evidence of PW.1, there is nothing on record to show that accused -4 has committed the offenses as alleged in the charge sheet.
As such benefit of doubt will have to be extended in favour of accused.
Hence, for the above reasons.
I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
11. Point No.2 :

In view of the above discussion,
accused found not guilty and hence, I proceed to pass the following :
 ORDER Acting under section 248(1) of Cr.P.C the accused-4 is acquitted of the offences punishable under section - 498A, 504, 506 of IPC and Section - 3 & 4 of D.P. Act.
Bail bond of accused-4 and her surety bond stands cancelled after six months from today.
